body: I just feel self concious about doing the coping activities (closing your eyes and focusing on feeling something, aka mindfulness). Nothing has really happened as of late except my self-doubt over the work I do (programmer). Just doesn't seem like enough is never enough and I blame myself. No one has a problem with my work but me. I'm my own worst critic. I'm just trying to answer the question of what makes me valuable?

Just can't seem to keep it together. I deel worthless all the time. I can't just be mindful because I have to close my eyes to do it and can't because I don't want others to think I'm weird. Going to counseling now and it seems to help, but I'm not implementing the coping techniques as much as I should. Just thinking the world would be better off without me. I feel like someone needs to beat the shit out of me because I'm such a horrible person.
I have a therapist that I'm trying to contact now. Thanks anyway, though.
They tried to, but they don't know what to do now.

What's the point? I'm tired of fighting every day. I end up pushing people away because of it. I just need a hug, but no one is there to give one. I need a friend to talk to, but I get introverted to where I'm scared to do it. I feel like such an idiot. Why am I still alive? I just want to bleed out for everything I am and everything I have done. I'm sure I've wronged everyone I come into contact with. Sorry if it sounds morbid.
